narrative: Reconciling provisioning, the SQL Server billing runs and the GL finds GBP 3.9M a year of revenue leakage (0.6% of revenue): 1,840 provisioned-but-unbilled assets, 6,300 lines on a superseded price list and CDR rating errors. GBP 0.45M has been recovered YTD.

signals.title: Billing leakage £3.9M a year (0.6% of revenue)
signals.excerpt: 1,840 provisioned-but-unbilled assets in the September billing run, 6,300 lines on a superseded price list, CDR rating errors after the March rate-table update.
